title: Cow Destroyer
description: The cows are i need of help so they have created a wand for you to help them.
body:
The cows need your help! 
Help them to repopulate the earth by spawning them by creating the Cooked Stick. Which it does require you to kill some cows, but this is a sacrifice they are willing to make for the betterment of cow society.

Go on comrade, help your fellow cows!

This mod Includes a 

Cooked Stick that spawns cows out of nowhere, cows that come from another universe.

The Compressed meat Block is also added which is a new block which is made out of, you guessed it Meat. Specificaly Raw Beef.

This Mod is more of a joke thing and more of a thing to have fun with and mess around just like how older mods used to be.
